result.brief: 提出自适应残差量化 VAE，对逐帧视频特征学习离散残差码并按帧截断，实现无标签的紧凑特征记忆，可迁移到视频表征与生成潜空间压缩。
result.reason: Proposes residual-quantized VAE tokenizer with adaptive per-frame truncation for compact video feature memory, a representation/tokenizer contribution transferable to latent-space and video representation goals.
